title: Executor runs the model's exact plan
summary: AlchemyExecutor decodes the manifest through the package model, plans against the supplied dependency floor, then runs each planned test with a deliberately constructed environment and bounded timeout/failure capture.
invariants: The executor does not discover dependencies from disk; it consumes a supplied dependency floor.
The executor does not invent REXX_PATH ordering; it uses AlchemyExecutionPlanner output.
Non-zero process return codes and timeout are execution evidence, not transport errors.
Reported environment is the model's bounded reportEnvironment rather than an uncontrolled environment dump.

provenance.claim: Executor and process runner consume the model plan.
Planner defines exact dependency and environment composition.
